info.name: VSN Ecommerce Android API — Complete Customer Collection
info.description: Complete customer-facing Postman collection for the VSN Ecommerce Android API. Mobile lifecycle uses /api/mobile/v1; commerce/business APIs reuse /api/v1 with the mobile Sanctum Bearer access token. Import the companion environment and run 01 → 02 → 03/04 → 06 for a normal flow. Admin/vendor routes are intentionally excluded from this Android customer collection.

request.description: Public Android app configuration: minimum/latest version, maintenance state and mobile feature contract.
Deep readiness. May intentionally fail if DB/Redis/workers/providers are not production-ready.
Refresh token rotates on every successful refresh. Collection automatically replaces access_token and refresh_token.
Open authorizationUrl in Android Custom Tab/browser. Callback returns a one-time app exchange code.
Returns signed-in user, wallet and unread counters for Android startup.

exec: let j={};try{j=pm.response.json()}catch(e){}; const rows=j?.data||[]; const other=rows.find(x=>!x.current)||rows[0]; if(other?.id) pm.environment.set('revoke_mobile_session_id',other.id);

request.description: Revokes every mobile session for the current user.

exec: let j={};try{j=pm.response.json()}catch(e){}; const p=j?.data?.items?.[0]; if(p){ if(p.id)pm.environment.set('product_id',p.id); if(p.slug)pm.environment.set('product_slug',p.slug); const v=p.variants?.[0]; if(v?.id)pm.environment.set('variant_id',v.id); }

request.description: Works for guests; bearer token makes it personalized.
Authenticated Android request; guest calls may instead use X-Device-Id without bearer.
Choose document files manually in Postman. Do not put real KYC data in shared environments.
Private authenticated file download. Change final segment to back, selfie or address-proof.

exec: let j={};try{j=pm.response.json()}catch(e){}; const d=j?.data?.devices||[]; const x=d.find(v=>!v.current)||d[0]; if(x?.id)pm.environment.set('security_device_id',x.id);
